answer_1.quote: The generative models have transformed the representation of KGC. The typical generative models of an encoder and a decoder, which can be viewed as P (y|x) = |y| i=1 P (y i |y <i , x), where x is the input sequence and y is the generated output sequence. In generative KGC, x represents the query Q = (s, r, ?, m) (or ?, r -1 , o, m ), and the predicted ground-truth object (or subject) as y.
answer_1.outputs: Predicted entities (as text) for knowledge graph completion

answer_2.quote: We employ the commonly used metrics of Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) and Hits@n (n ∈ {1, 3, 10}) to evaluate the outcomes of KGC.
